no_vcs.name: niwrap-niftyreg

It is freely available under the Mozilla Public License v2.0.

no_vcs.name: niwrap-greedy
no_vcs.summary: Greedy is a tool for fast deformable registration of 2D and 3D medical images. Developed at the Penn Image Computing and Science Lab (PICSL), it was designed for really fast CPU-based deformable image registration in applications where many images must be registered in parallel, such as multi-atlas segmentation.
